title: HTTP Forge Notices
description: In-app notices shown to users. Single source of truth for bundled and remote notices.

id.description: Unique notice ID. Used as globalState key. Bump to re-show.

message.description: The message displayed to the user.

actionUrl.description: URL to open when the action button is clicked.

trigger.description: When to show: 'activation' (on startup) or 'execution' (after N requests).

thresholds.description: Execution count thresholds (only for trigger: 'execution'). If multiple thresholds are set, 'Dismiss' re-prompts at the next threshold. If a single threshold, dismissal is permanent.
